diff_summary: Extracted the principal team authorization guard into one helper called by both reservation handlers.

verification.command: .venv/bin/python -c "import ast,subprocess; p='backend/app/main.py'; s=open(p).read(); n=next(n for n in ast.parse(s).body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='reserve_pit_auto'); subprocess.run(['.venv/bin/ruff','check','--select','C901','--stdin-filename',p,'-'],input=ast.get_source_segment(s,n),text=True,check=True)" && .venv/bin/ruff format --check backend/app/main.py
